In the initial phase, all reviewers gave negative scores (4, 4, 4, 2). They raised concerns from different aspects.

Reviewer WjNt has concerns on the novelty, limitation of counting small objects, and lack of study on the iterative process.
Reviewer 9GU5 has concerns on the efficiency, lack of convergence guarantees, unclear description, and insufficient analysis.
Reviewer vU7v has concerns on the efficiency, the importance of training-free counting approach, and the necessity of TS-SS.
Reviewer tXFk has concerns on the efficiency, and lack of details regarding the method.
